---
title: "A Foreign Investment Uncertainty Index for Australia and the United States"
date: "2021-04-16"
categories: ["Foreign Investment"]
---

I have a new report out with the United States Studies Centre, [A Foreign Investment Uncertainty Index for Australia and the United States](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/a-foreign-investment-uncertainty-index-for-australia-and-the-united-states). The index helps quantify the uncertainty generated by our regulation of FDI at the border and its economic implications.

[John Kehoe](https://www.afr.com/policy/economy/foreign-investment-uncertainty-jumps-20210415-p57jfq) writes up the story in today’s AFR. [Michael Heath](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-04-15/australia-foreign-investment-uncertainty-spikes-as-tensions-rise) also has a story in Bloomberg.
